<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 1"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Practiced Brawn](/Feats.aspx?ID=5324) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Centaur" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=747" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 31

</column>

---

You're accustomed to long days filled with hard physical labor. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) checks to [Force Open](/Actions.aspx?ID=2375) and [Shove](/Actions.aspx?ID=2380), and to Fortitude saving throws to resist becoming [fatigued](/Conditions.aspx?ID=73). When you roll a success on an Athletics check to Shove, you get a critical success instead.
name: Practiced Brawn
